newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Tropical Depression 5 update -- NWS.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Tropical Depression 5 update -- NWS.

text.p: The following update on Tropical Depression 5 (to be called Erika if upgraded to a tropical storm) issued by the National Weather Service (NWS) in Miami, Florida, using observations at 0500 EDT/0900 GMT:
(270 miles east of Windward Islands of the Lesser
Comments: The center of the storm is poorly organized, with little change in its strength or path expected over the next 24 hours.
A tropical depression is upgraded to a tropical storm when its maximum sustained winds reach at least 39 mph.
